verdict.rationale: Stripe's own tax documentation says it automates sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all transactions, which is a first-party capability covering the core of the story. However, the evidence is a single high-level line: it never shows tax being calculated on Billing invoices, nor how registrations or jurisdiction rates are handled. Missing for 10: documented automatic tax calculation on invoices, registration management, jurisdiction rate handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates

citations.quote: Automate sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all your transactions.
